_source: The real order lifecycle — these are the OrderStatus values the backend moves an order through: PLACED → VENDOR_ACCEPTED → DELIVERY_ASSIGNED / OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED.

items.title: Choose what you need
items.body: Browse shops near you and add to your cart.

items.title: Place your order
items.body: Pay securely, or on delivery where the vendor allows it.

items.title: The shop accepts
items.body: A verified local vendor confirms and packs it.

items.title: A rider brings it
items.body: Assigned to a partner near the shop and tracked to your door.
